_comment: Report publishing, using the same config keys as apitest-commons/S3Adapter.java in the MOSIP api-testrig. Precedence is CLI flag > this file > environment, so CI can override everything with secrets. Leave push-reports-to-s3 false for local runs; runner/s3_upload.py reads this file by default.

_keys.push-reports-to-s3: on/off switch; runner/s3_upload.py is a no-op while this is false
_keys.s3-host: MinIO or S3-compatible endpoint. Omit for AWS S3; the region is then used to build the URL.
_keys.s3-region: AWS region, also part of the SigV4 signing scope
_keys.s3-user-key: access key id. AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID is accepted as an alias.
_keys.s3-user-secret: secret access key. AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY is accepted as an alias.
_keys.s3-account: bucket. The api-testrig default is "automationtests", which is also the fallback here.
_keys.reportExpirationInDays: retention metadata for the published reports
_keys.s3-prefix: object key prefix. Objects land at <prefix>/<run-id>/<path relative to --source>.
